prompts.prompt: Slow push-in. A woman in a silk robe stands on a balcony at sunrise, the robe and her hair moving in the breeze, she slowly turns to the camera and smiles, holding the robe loosely. Golden warm backlight, city or sea behind her, cinematic, photorealistic, 4K.

prompts.title: Lendo no sofá
prompts.prompt: Static camera, medium shot. A woman in casual loungewear lies on a sofa with her legs up reading a book, she slowly lowers the book to reveal her face and looks at the camera with a soft smile. Warm cozy living room light, shallow depth of field, cinematic, photorealistic.

prompts.title: Dançando sozinha em casa
prompts.prompt: Static camera, slight push-in. A woman in a tank top and shorts dances slowly and playfully in her living room, swaying and running a hand through her hair, laughing toward the camera. Warm home lighting, natural and candid, cinematic, photorealistic.

prompts.title: Olhando pela janela
prompts.prompt: Slow push-in. A woman in a slip stands by a large window gazing outside, soft light on her skin, she slowly turns from profile toward the camera with a gentle, thoughtful smile. Hazy golden window light, intimate mood, cinematic, photorealistic.

prompts.title: Relax no spa
prompts.desc: toalha na nuca, cabeça pro lado
prompts.prompt: Static camera, medium close-up. A woman with a towel wrapped around her relaxes on a spa lounger, she slowly tilts her head back and to the side with eyes closed, then opens them to the camera and smiles. Soft warm spa lighting, steam, serene, cinematic, photorealistic.

prompts.title: Se arrumando no espelho
prompts.prompt: Static camera behind her, reflection in a vanity mirror. A woman in a robe applies a touch of makeup at a vanity, she slowly leans toward the mirror then catches the camera's reflection and gives a playful smile. Warm bulb-lit vanity light, cinematic, photorealistic.

prompts.title: Sol na janela
prompts.prompt: Static camera, slow push-in. A woman in delicate loungewear stands in a beam of afternoon sun by a window, she slowly stretches and lets the light wash over her, then turns to the camera with a soft smile. Warm sunlight, floating dust particles, cinematic, photorealistic, 4K.

prompts.title: No tapete, aconchegante
prompts.prompt: Camera above, slow push-in. A woman in cozy loungewear lies on a soft rug by a fireplace, she slowly rolls onto her back and looks up at the camera with a relaxed smile, hair spread out. Warm firelight glow, intimate, cinematic, photorealistic.

prompts.title: Trocando atrás do biombo
prompts.prompt: Static camera. A woman's soft silhouette moves slowly behind a decorative folding screen, then she steps out from the side wrapped in a robe, looking at the camera with a playful smile. Warm backlight through the screen, tasteful, cinematic, photorealistic.
